description: FAULTLINE v4 'Under Quarantine' hostile bodies (1024 x 1024 on a flat charcoal backdrop, cut out into atlases by scripts/compose_sheet.py) and the crate illustration (opaque, card anchor at 0.8). Bodies use LoRA 0.6 and the card's resolution-dependent shift (no constant shift: the first Spark Mite held its silhouette, and constant 1.15 changed nothing visible). Anchor: docs/art-refs/hostile-anchor-drone.png (cell 0 of hostiles.png, 724 x 724 at x 0, y 0). The design's Coil Serpent crop (docs/art-refs/hostile-anchor.png) was evaluated first and rejected: its emerald scales leaked into every body at LoRA 0.3-1.0, and at 0.3-0.45 the serpent itself reappeared. Two per-entry exceptions (see anchorNote): the Spark Mite uses the serpent crop turned teal (hostile-anchor-teal.png), the Chorister the Hollow Choir cell (hostile-anchor-choir.png). promptAddendum marks the only prompt changes (appended to the design's verbatim prompt, never replacing it). Same runtime and model revisions as the v3 passes; rendered with scripts/generate_stage_art.py --manifest <this file>; entries 'file' = the chosen candidate, 'sheet' = its atlas cell, 'cutoutKeys' = manual colour-key boxes (design 14.3 manual masking).

hostiles-escorts.composedBy: uv run scripts/compose_sheet.py --manifest docs/art-v4-bodies-manifest.json --sheet hostiles-escorts --output artifacts/v4-sheets-04

hostiles-front.composedBy: uv run scripts/compose_sheet.py --manifest docs/art-v4-bodies-manifest.json --sheet hostiles-front --output artifacts/v4-sheets-front-03

hostiles-adds.composedBy: uv run scripts/compose_sheet.py --manifest docs/art-v4-bodies-manifest.json --sheet hostiles-adds --output artifacts/v4-sheets-adds-01

images.name: Spark Mite
images.effect: Escort: a small swarm cutter whose bite grows with every other hostile alive.
images.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one finished square game sprite painting of a single small hostile machine, full body, centered with 10 percent padding, on a flat uniform very dark charcoal backdrop with no floor, no ground plane and no cast shadow, ready to be cut out. FAULTLINE, a ruined orbital cathedral network tactics card game. Subject: Spark Mite, a fist-sized weathered brass tick with six hooked segmented legs, a chipped ivory carapace and one oversized serrated mandible; a single bright teal electric spark arcs between the mandible tips and lights the face from below. Strong readable silhouette, no motion blur, no backgrounds, no frames, no UI, no text, no logos, no watermark.

images.anchorNote: The Mite alone uses the design anchor (the Coil Serpent crop) with its green hue turned to teal (hostile-anchor-teal.png): the serpent anchor is the only one that paints the arcing spark, and teal is the Mite own accent, so the leak becomes its feature. The spark strands are colour-keyed against the backdrop inside cutoutKeys (compose_sheet.py --key).

images.name: Crate
images.effect: Crate reveal plate and reward screen: a sealed hazard crate opening.
images.prompt: A dark atmospheric science-fantasy collectible-card painting, matching the painted look of the reference. A sealed heavy brass supply crate banded with worn red-and-ivory hazard stripes standing on a dark scarred table inside a ruined orbital cathedral, its riveted lid lifting a hand's width on stiff hinges, warm amber light spilling out from inside across the table and the broken seal, dust drifting in the beam. One clear object centered with room around it, a reward about to be opened. Chipped brass, cracked ivory fittings, dark cables, deep indigo shadows. Rich layered oil-paint brushwork, softly broken painted edges, muted colours, dramatic shadow. No photography, smooth studio-product rendering, text, labels, border or interface.
